steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure the event as a reverse buy auction with lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title using the runner's generated title.
Select the first available auction template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the named product as one line item with the required quantity of 10.
Render and fill the pricing sheet for the added line item.
Set the first row's plant or delivery location to LOC-0001.
Verify that Quantity Requested remains 10 after moving through the sheet.
Verify that the requested plant location is retained in the first row.
Verify that the Total Amount cell is populated once the filled pricing sheet has a price value.
Keep the default Start now schedule with a 30-minute duration and save it.
Add one available QA test vendor so the event can be published.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
